## Personality

Martin is considered by others to be unreliable. He is tasked with looking after a large amount of stock on the premises.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)_

## History

Martin was hired to work at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) a year prior to Matthew's sudden death. During his tenure, he experienced bad luck with the livestock, having four cows die on his watch.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. ## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--martin.md)

Martin works at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as a hired hand and driver for [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). He assists her by managing farm tasks and handling transportation duties for the household. His presence provides essential manual labor to support [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) in maintaining her property.

- Serves under — drives for her and works at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII.
